title: docs(skills): name the pluralLabel exception to "an extension can add but never remove"

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能「对象扩展」一节仍说扩展“只能加、不能删”，但补上唯一的例外：扩展改了 `label` 却没给 `pluralLabel` 时，基础对象的复数名会被清掉（租户自己写的复数除外），要保留就两个一起写。
- 为什么改：PR #30459（#30391）落地后合并规则就是这样，原句对 `pluralLabel` 不再准确；这是那次合同评审的 should-fix 2。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文档一句话，无代码、无 schema 变化；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 第 349–350 行；规则出处 `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `mergeObjectDefinitions`（第 916 行）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep "objectstack-data/SKILL.md  "`，预期 `6122 / 6123`。
- 需要你做的：ADR-0029 D9.2 第 473 行“has no expression for *removal* at all”一句是否加修订注，由你定（本 PR 不碰 ADR）。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` § Object Extension Model keeps "an extension can add but never remove" and names the one exception: a new `label` without `pluralLabel` clears the base plural unless a tenant authored it, so an author sets both.
- The rule is read off `origin/main`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `mergeObjectDefinitions`: `if (extension.pluralLabel === undefined && extension.label !== merged.label && !yields('pluralLabel')) delete merged.pluralLabel;`, inside the `extension.label !== undefined && !yields('label')` branch. So the plural survives when the extension repeats the running label, when the tenant authored the plural (the ADR-0029 D9.2a yield), or when the tenant authored the label (the label itself yields).
- Token payment, same file: the Lifecycle Hooks pointer line drops its parenthetical second link to `references/data-hooks.md`. That file is already linked from the catalog list (L46) and from the backfill paragraph (L160), so the parenthetical restated a link.
- `.changeset/30466-extension-plurallabel-exception.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Tests

Docs-only. No behaviour changes, so no test or ablation applies.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope by the order, for the seat to raise for Tier H: ADR-0029 D9.2, `docs/adr/0029-kernel-object-ownership-and-platform-objects-decomposition.md` L472–473, "`mergeObjectDefinitions` merges fields additively (...) and has no expression for *removal* at all." Since PR #30459 it has one, for `pluralLabel`. No decision moves (the sentence argues about fields in an overlay); whether it gets an amendment note is the maintainer's.
